title: VIBE: Video Instruction-aligned Background music gEneration
abstract: arXiv:2608.30125v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Current video-to-music (V2M) models lack semantic control and fail to penalize instruction violations, largely due to their reliance on reconstruction objectives and the representational bottleneck of static cross-modal conditioning in Diffusion Autoregressive (DAR) architectures. To resolve this, we introduce VIBE, a novel text-and-video-to-music (T+V2M) generation model that leverages: (1) Conditioning Connection, a depth-wise cross-layer conditioning mechanism that dynamically bridges the planning and diffusion refinement heads and (2) a comprehensive reward modeling taxonomy, optimizing for both hard, verifiable constraints (e.g., tempo, key) and soft, subjective qualities (e.g., musicality, multimodal alignment) with a structured 5-stage training curriculum. translated_title: VIBE：视频指令对齐的背景音乐生成
translated_abstract: 当前的视频到音乐（V2M）模型缺乏语义控制能力，且无法对指令违反进行惩罚，这主要归因于其对重建目标的依赖，以及扩散自回归（DAR）架构中静态跨模态条件化所造成的表示瓶颈。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了VIBE，一种新颖的文本与视频到音乐（T+V2M）生成模型，其核心包括：(1) 条件连接，一种深度跨层条件化机制，能够动态桥接规划头与扩散细化头；(2) 一套全面的奖励建模分类体系，通过结构化的5阶段训练课程，同时优化硬性可验证约束（如节奏、调性）和软性主观质量（如音乐性、多模态对齐）。通过采用视听对齐、指令遵循和音频质量等指标进行评估，并结合主观人类评估研究，我们观察到VIBE表现出……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: VIBE提出了一种文本与视频到音乐的生成模型，通过深度跨层条件连接机制动态桥接规划与扩散细化模块，并利用涵盖硬性可验证约束和软性主观质量的双层奖励建模体系，实现了对背景音乐生成的精细语义指令控制。
en_tdlr: VIBE is a novel text-and-video-to-music generation model that achieves fine-grained semantic instruction control over background music through a depth-wise cross-layer conditioning mechanism and a dual-level reward modeling taxonomy optimizing both hard verifiable constraints and soft subjective qualities.
